text: accel_step formation is nearly the same at N=16 (steps 75-90) and N=64 (steps 85-90), even though the two baselines and loss scales differ a lot. Does formation instead line up with a fixed training-step window, or with a fixed fraction of step-0 val MSE? At N=16 it happens at val_mse_ratio 0.08-0.10, about 2% of the step-0 value. Comparing the same fraction at N=64 and N=256 would tell these apart.
